data.counter-processor-agent.yaml:
agents:
- description: 'Processes enriched user events and maintains real-time counters for
    various dimensions.

    Performs lookups against user profiles for additional enrichment.

    '
  input:
    channel: null
    declare: null
    take: null
    topic:
      compacting: null
      config: null
      deleting: null
      key_serializer: null
      name: enriched-user-events
      partitions: null
      pattern: null
      replicas: null
      retention: null
      value_serializer: null
  isolated_partitions: null
  name: counter-processor
  noack: null
  output:
    topics:
    - ack: null
      compacting: null
      config: null
      declare: false
      deleting: null
      headers_selector: null
      key_selector:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def get_key(value):\n    return f\"metrics:{value['dimension']}:{value['time_window']}\"\
          \n"
      key_serializer: null
      name: real-time-metrics
      name_selector: null
      partition_selector: null
      partitions: null
      pass_through: false
      predicate: null
      replicas: null
      retention: null
      value_selector:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def get_value(value):\n    return value[\"metrics\"]\n"
      value_serializer: null
    - ack: null
      compacting: null
      config: null
      declare: false
      deleting: null
      headers_selector: null
      key_selector:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def get_key(value):\n    return value[\"user_id\"]\n"
      key_serializer: null
      name: user-segments-updated
      name_selector: null
      partition_selector: null
      partitions: null
      pass_through: false
      predicate:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def should_send(value):\n    return \"segment_data\" in value\n"
      replicas: null
      retention: null
      value_selector:
        entrypoint: null
        python: "def get_value(value):\n    return value[\"segment_data\"]\n"
      value_serializer: null
  processors:
    init:
      entrypoint: null
      python: "from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta\nfrom collections\
        \ import defaultdict\nimport os\nimport math\n\napp = context[\"app\"]\n\n\
        # Configuration from environment\nWINDOW_SIZE_MINUTES = int(os.getenv(\"WINDOW_SIZE_MINUTES\"\
        , \"5\"))\nMAX_COUNTERS_PER_KEY = int(os.getenv(\"MAX_COUNTERS_PER_KEY\",\
        \ \"1000\"))\n\ndef get_time_window(timestamp, window_minutes=WINDOW_SIZE_MINUTES):\n\
        \    \"\"\"Get the time window bucket for a timestamp.\"\"\"\n    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp,\
        \ tz=timezone.utc)\n    # Round down to the nearest window_minutes interval\n\
        \    minutes = (dt.minute // window_minutes) * window_minutes\n    window_start\
        \ = dt.replace(minute=minutes, second=0, microsecond=0)\n    return window_start.isoformat()\n\
        \ndef calculate_user_segment(profile, recent_activity):\n    \"\"\"Calculate\
        \ user segment based on profile and recent activity.\"\"\"\n    # Simple segmentation\
        \ logic\n    total_events = profile.get(\"total_events\", 0)\n    days_since_signup\
        \ = profile.get(\"days_since_signup\", 0)\n    avg_daily_events = total_events\
        \ / max(days_since_signup, 1)\n    \n    recent_purchases = recent_activity.get(\"\
        purchase_count\", 0)\n    recent_logins = recent_activity.get(\"login_count\"\
        , 0)\n    \n    if recent_purchases >= 2:\n        return \"high_value\"\n\
        \    elif recent_logins >= 5 and avg_daily_events > 10:\n        return \"\
        active_user\"\n    elif days_since_signup <= 7:\n        return \"new_user\"\
        \n    elif recent_logins == 0:\n        return \"dormant\"\n    else:\n  \
        \      return \"regular_user\"\n        \n"
    operations:
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: lookup_profile
        python: "def lookup_profile(value, profiles):\n    \"\"\"\n    Looks up user\
          \ profile information and adds it to the event.\n    \"\"\"\n    user_id\
          \ = value[\"user_id\"]\n    profile = profiles.get(user_id, {\n        \"\
          user_id\": user_id,\n        \"total_events\": 0,\n        \"first_seen\"\
          : value[\"timestamp\"],\n        \"signup_date\": value.get(\"event_date\"\
          ),\n        \"country\": value.get(\"country_name\", \"Unknown\"),\n   \
          \     \"segments\": []\n    })\n    \n    # Calculate days since signup\n\
          \    if profile.get(\"signup_date\"):\n        signup_date = datetime.fromisoformat(profile[\"\
          signup_date\"])\n        current_date = datetime.fromisoformat(value[\"\
          event_date\"])\n        days_since_signup = (current_date - signup_date).days\n\
          \        profile[\"days_since_signup\"] = days_since_signup\n    \n    return\
          \ {\n        **value,\n        \"user_profile\": profile\n    }\n    \n"
      name: lookup-user-profile
      tables:
      - name: user-profiles
        param_name: profiles
      topic_send: null
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: update_counters
        python: "def update_counters(value, counters):\n    \"\"\"\n    Updates various\
          \ dimensional counters based on the event.\n    \"\"\"\n    timestamp =\
          \ float(value[\"timestamp\"])\n    time_window = get_time_window(timestamp)\n\
          \    event_type = value[\"event_type\"]\n    country = value.get(\"country_name\"\
          , \"Unknown\")\n    user_id = value[\"user_id\"]\n    \n    # Define dimensions\
          \ to count\n    dimensions = [\n        f\"global:total:{time_window}\"\
          ,\n        f\"event_type:{event_type}:{time_window}\",\n        f\"country:{country}:{time_window}\"\
          ,\n        f\"hour:{value['event_hour']}:{time_window}\",\n        f\"weekend:{value['is_weekend']}:{time_window}\"\
          \n    ]\n    \n    updated_counters = []\n    \n    for dimension in dimensions:\n\
          \        counter = counters.get(dimension, {\n            \"count\": 0,\n\
          \            \"unique_users\": set(),\n            \"first_event\": timestamp,\n\
          \            \"last_event\": timestamp,\n            \"dimension\": dimension,\n\
          \            \"time_window\": time_window\n        })\n        \n      \
          \  # Update counter\n        counter[\"count\"] += 1\n        counter[\"\
          unique_users\"].add(user_id)\n        counter[\"last_event\"] = max(counter[\"\
          last_event\"], timestamp)\n        \n        # Convert set to list for serialization,\
          \ keep only count\n        serializable_counter = {\n            **counter,\n\
          \            \"unique_user_count\": len(counter[\"unique_users\"])\n   \
          \     }\n        del serializable_counter[\"unique_users\"]\n        \n\
          \        counters[dimension] = counter  # Keep set in table\n        updated_counters.append(serializable_counter)\n\
          \    \n    return {\n        **value,\n        \"updated_counters\": updated_counters,\n\
          \        \"time_window\": time_window\n    }\n    \n"
      name: update-counters
      tables:
      - name: event-counters
        param_name: counters
      topic_send: null
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: calculate_segments
        python: "def calculate_segments(value, profiles, counters):\n    \"\"\"\n\
          \    Updates user segments based on recent activity patterns.\n    \"\"\"\
          \n    user_id = value[\"user_id\"]\n    profile = value[\"user_profile\"\
          ]\n    time_window = value[\"time_window\"]\n    \n    # Get recent activity\
          \ from counters\n    recent_activity = {}\n    for event_type in [\"login\"\
          , \"purchase\", \"page_view\"]:\n        counter_key = f\"user:{user_id}:event_type:{event_type}:{time_window}\"\
          \n        counter = counters.get(counter_key, {\"count\": 0})\n        recent_activity[f\"\
          {event_type}_count\"] = counter[\"count\"]\n    \n    # Calculate new segment\n\
          \    new_segment = calculate_user_segment(profile, recent_activity)\n  \
          \  \n    # Update profile\n    updated_profile = {\n        **profile,\n\
          \        \"total_events\": profile[\"total_events\"] + 1,\n        \"last_seen\"\
          : value[\"timestamp\"],\n        \"current_segment\": new_segment,\n   \
          \     \"last_updated\": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()\n    }\n\
          \    \n    # Add to segments history if segment changed\n    if profile.get(\"\
          current_segment\") != new_segment:\n        segments = profile.get(\"segments\"\
          , [])\n        segments.append({\n            \"segment\": new_segment,\n\
          \            \"timestamp\": value[\"timestamp\"],\n            \"trigger_event\"\
          : value[\"event_type\"]\n        })\n        # Keep only last 10 segments\n\
          \        updated_profile[\"segments\"] = segments[-10:]\n    \n    profiles[user_id]\
          \ = updated_profile\n    \n    result = {**value}\n    if profile.get(\"\
          current_segment\") != new_segment:\n        result[\"segment_data\"] = {\n\
          \            \"user_id\": user_id,\n            \"old_segment\": profile.get(\"\
          current_segment\"),\n            \"new_segment\": new_segment,\n       \
          \     \"change_timestamp\": value[\"timestamp\"]\n        }\n    \n    return\
          \ result\n    \n"
      name: calculate-segments
      tables:
      - name: user-profiles
        param_name: profiles
      - name: event-counters
        param_name: counters
      topic_send: null
    - filter: null
      map:
        entrypoint: emit_metrics
        python: "def emit_metrics(value):\n    \"\"\"\n    Emits metrics for each\
          \ updated counter.\n    \"\"\"\n    for counter in value[\"updated_counters\"\
          ]:\n        yield {\n            \"dimension\": counter[\"dimension\"],\n\
          \            \"time_window\": counter[\"time_window\"],\n            \"\
          metrics\": counter\n        }"
      name: emit-metrics
      tables: []
      topic_send: null
    pipeline:
    - lookup-user-profile
    - update-counters
    - calculate-segments
    - emit-metrics
